desc:
💡 The sound of fluorescent yellow lights buzzing at intervals whilst moist though not damp brown carpet fills the air with uneasiness. Noclip through reality and force your way towards freedom. It is your task to discover and find out what lies beyond The Backrooms 🚪. 

[The Backrooms 🚪 has 32 levels, 3 endings.]

( 🛠 Major update underway.)

❗ IMPORTANT: Level saves are based on badges, deleting them WILL remove your progress. Servers in each level range from 1-8 people(s) capacity. Expect bugs/lag as the game is still in development. 

❗ {Use R15 & AVOID UGC characters to ensure smooth collisions}

- Special thanks to BottiDuckk for art, The Backrooms OST by Crossing Bridges & Violet A. Foster, Loyalty Freak Music (OST), some items were used by permission

💻📱🎮 - Supports PC, Mobile, Console & VR (Experimental)

- Inspired by The Backrooms Wiki, Apeirophobia and K. Pixels

Tags: Poolrooms, Phobia, Dreamcore, Weirdcore, Horror, Puzzle, Explore, Maze, Survival, Adventure, Liminal
